description: Solar UV intensity breakout board with Genicom GUVA-S12SD photodiode and on-board op-amp, analog output

ports.label: VCC / GND
ports.note: não publicado para esta placa clone; o MCP6241 do projeto de referência opera de 1,8 a 5,5 V e estes módulos costumam ser usados a 3,3 ou 5 V — a confirmar

ports.label: SIG (saída analógica)
ports.note: exige um ADC no host; o resistor de ganho desta placa não é publicado, a curva precisa ser medida

specs.sensing-element: gallium nitride Schottky photodiode, photovoltaic mode, good visible blindness

photocurrent.note: nanoamperes; dark current measured at Vr = 1 V

communications.interface: analog voltage output (no digital bus), needs an ADC on the host

pinout.name: SIG
pinout.description: analog output from the on-board transimpedance amplifier

supply-voltage.note: not published for this clone board; the op-amp in the reference design (MCP6241) works from 1.8 to 5.5 V and these modules are normally used at 3.3 or 5 V - to be confirmed

output-formula.note: output voltage = amplifier gain x photocurrent; the reference circuit (6.8 Mohm, Vcc 5 V) gives Vout = 0.2 x UV index + 0.6 under sunlight, but the gain resistor of this particular board is not published - must be measured or calibrated
